svg.aria-label: Setting up PassKi: 1. generate the files with passkiSetup (or by hand), which reads your debug and release signing keys and the Xcode app ID (add the Play App Signing key with extraFingerprints) and writes assetlinks.json, the apple-app-site-association file and the iOS entitlement; 2. publish them on your domain at /.well-known/ and allow the printed origins on your server, while Google and Apple fetch the files; 3. check everything with passkiCheck, in CI, and with PasskeyDoctor on a device.
